entries.note: Round 2 (fr/ru re-audit after translator fix commit 7e6d2b7ac); round 1 for the rest (same session). Independent audit of all 37 keys against en/wire.voice.json + wire.voice.context.json, i18n/glossary.md, the locale style guide and neighbouring wire.settings.speech / wire.voice_availability. Scripted over all 37 keys: key set equals en; {placeholders} identical to en ({session_id},{reason},{limit_mib},{detail}); no ICU plural/select arms in this namespace; identifiers text_origin/qwen_s2s, WAV/WebM/Ogg/MP4, UUID, MiB, Radient and ElevenLabs preserved; no bidi/zero-width controls, no ASCII quotes, no markdown/digit/symbol in the 6 spoken wire.voice.phrase.* strings; max_spoken_chars.help quotes phrase.truncated exactly. target_sha256 is the file audited (post-fix for fr/ru). Glossary/neighbour consistency: conversation, agent, approvals, provider, key and 'try again in a moment' match the shipped corpus of the locale. Back-translations of the 10 most consequential strings (approval/refusal/limit/provider), all faithful: approval_pending: First answer the question or the approval shown on screen.; phrase.on_screen_first: First answer the approval on screen.; not_enabled: Voice mode isn't activated for this conversation. Activate it first for this conversation.; rate_limited_minute: The voice provider's per-minute limit is reached. Try again in a moment.; rate_limited_day: The voice provider's daily limit is exhausted. Try again after its reset.; upload_too_large: This recording is too bulky. Keep it under {limit_mib} MiB.; provider.help: Who listens to you and speaks for you, for hands-free voice and the read-aloud button. Radient is billed against your Radient credit; ElevenLabs uses your own key. Only the one you choose is used, and if it can't handle a request it says why instead of switching.; provider.choice.none.description: No provider chosen for now. Hands-free voice stays off until you choose one.; provider.choice.elevenlabs.description: Your own ElevenLabs API key. ElevenLabs bills you directly.; provider_unset: First choose a voice provider: Radient or your own ElevenLabs key. Voice mode only uses the one you choose.. Re-audit round 2 of the 5 changed fr keys (invalid_request, empty_transcript, invalid_request_id, provider.help, provider_unset): diff vs the audited text is exactly U+0020->U+202F before ';'/':' and nothing else; back-translations unchanged in meaning. nit: provider.help 'facturé sur votre crédit' (alt. 'débité de votre crédit'). Round 1 found 5 minors (plain space before ; and : instead of U+202F, fr.md Punctuation) — fixed in 7e6d2b7ac, verified. Not verified: the English 'Speak button' is a UI label; the locale renders it descriptively as a read-aloud button and the client's real label was not checked here. No rendered, native-speaker, or RTL rendering claim (ur: strings only; bidi handled by the render layer per the style guide). Same model family as the translator, different session and brief.

entries.note: Independent audit of the review-round delta of wire.voice against en/wire.voice.json + wire.voice.context.json, i18n/glossary.md, the locale style guide and the already-audited neighbours (store_busy for 'try again in a moment', approval_pending/phrase.on_screen_first, 'command' as used in cli.sessions_help, 'conversation' as in not_enabled/switched). Source, context and target sha256 recomputed from the files on disk and equal the translator receipt. Scripted over all 43 keys: key set equals en; {placeholders} identical ({title} in spoken.approval_needed, none in invalid_message); NFC; no bidi/zero-width/format controls; no ASCII quotes. fr: U+202F before ':' in spoken.approval_needed and invalid_message, apostrophe U+2019; ru: 'чуть позже' as in store_busy; zh-CN: full-width ：，。（） throughout; ur: ۔ stops, no bidi controls; hi: danda, 'थोड़ी देर बाद फिर कोशिश करें' as in store_busy. spoken.* strings are short plain words, spoken.link is one word, spoken.code_omitted keeps the English parenthesis pair (optional per context), terms match the shipped corpus (approval, link, code block, sync, command). Back-translations: session_syncing: This conversation is still syncing. Try again in a moment. approval_needed: Approval required: {title}. approval_needed_untitled: Approval required. code_omitted: (code block omitted) link: link invalid_message: This message was not sent: it is too long or looks like a command. Same model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5), different session and brief. Text-level audit only: no rendered, TTS-playback, native-speaker or RTL rendering check performed.
